examples.title: Register with DI

sections.title: Dependency injection
sections.text: See [`Lyo.Compression`](../Lyo.Compression/README.md) for the full registration tree, keyed services, `ICompressionResolver`, and `CompressionServiceOptions` binding. **File storage reads:** register `AddZstdCompressor()` when historical metadata may reference Zstd; decompression uses `ICompressionResolver`, not only `ICompressionService.DefaultAlgorithm`.
